Name: Cuter Slimes Refreshed
Author: JennaJuffuffles
Description:
This mod replaces slime sprites with cuter designs! 

[b][size=4][color=#c9daf8]Features ✧ °｡⋆✦･ﾟ ✧[/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Two visual styles: Glossy (totally opaque) and Jelly (just a little bit see-through!)[/*]
[*]Cuter Green Slimes out in the world and in your hutch! Plus Big Slimes, Tiger Slimes, and even dangerous Green Slimes too![/*]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/21889/21889-1771895404-793992574.png[/img]

[b][size=3]✧ Requirements ✧ [/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.8.1+[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3]✧ Compatibility ✧ [/size][/b]
Optional support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32241]Monster Variety[/url] for cuter slimes in MV's variety system:
[list]
[*]Adds all of the classic Cuter Slimes to MV![/*]
[*]Plus adds a new SUPER BOBBLE version of Green Slime[/*]
[*]Kittybob version of Tiger Slime =^..^=[/*]
[*]And extra playful doodlebobs for dangerous slimes![/*]
[/list]Works well on its own [i]or[/i] with other MV packs!

[b][size=3]✧ Configuration ✧ [/size][/b]
[spoiler]
Edit config.json in the [CP] Cuter Slimes Refreshed folder, or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] in-game (recommended).

Default settings:
[code]
{
"Mode": "jelly", // can also be "glossy"
"MVDefaultTextureOnly": "false" // will only use the original Cuter Slime textures for MonsterVariety
}[/code][/spoiler]
